title: Causal Agent Replay: Counterfactual Attribution for LLM-Agent Failures
why: Found in the pre-Phase-E freshness sweep (2026-07-04). Proposes Causal Agent Replay (CAR): a NEW attribution method using do-calculus interventions over an agent trajectory modeled as a structural causal model, including a do_observation operation that substitutes a tool observation — genuinely overlapping machinery with B2.5's twin-replay oracle. Concede-and-differentiate: CAR proposes and validates a REPLACEMENT attributor on synthetic SCMs with planted ground truth; it does not test whether EXISTING published attribution methods (Who&When's LLM judges, AgenTracer's tracer) systematically misattribute blame specifically under a schema-valid, semantically corrupted (vs. overt) tool observation on real agent benchmarks — that empirical question, and the matched-control/direction-of-bias measurement, remains B2.5's distinct contribution. Not a pre-emption (different estimand: propose-new-method vs. measure-existing-methods'-bias), but genuinely the closest-yet-found method-twin on the causal-intervention-for-attribution machinery; should get a concede-and-differentiate sentence in Related Work.
